chunks: "O Lord, take away this torment from us," (they will pray); "we have come to believe."
ai.seo_question: What do the people of Hellfire pray when asked to remove the torment?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often interpreted through the lens of *Tafsir al-Qummi* and *Al-Mizan*, where the phrase 'indeed we are believers' is seen as a delayed affirmation or a specific type of faith that arrives too late for salvation. It underscores the concept of *Tawbah* (repentance) being valid only until the soul reaches the throat, highlighting the finality of divine decree once the punishment is fully enacted. This supplication serves as a poignant reminder of the consequences of delaying recognition of truth during one's lifetime.
